Here’s the idiomatic `knr-ops` implementation for the new logs bucket, IRSA role, and Flux kustomization.

### 📁 Directory Structure
```
infra/s3-logs/
├── base/
│   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   ├── bucket.yaml
│   ├── iam.yaml
│   └── serviceaccount.yaml
├── overlays/
│   ├── dev/
│   │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   │   └── patch-env.yaml
│   └── prod/
│       ├── kustomization.yaml
│       └── patch-env.yaml
flux/
└── kustomizations.yaml  # (append new entries)
```

---

### 📄 Base Manifests

**`infra/s3-logs/base/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - iam.yaml
  - serviceaccount.yaml
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: s3-logs
    app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: flux
spec:
  forProvider:
    region: us-east-1
    bucket: myapp-logs-ENV
    versioning:
      enabled: true
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      rule:
        applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
          sseAlgorithm: AES256
    publicAccessBlock:
      blockPublicAcls: true
      blockPublicPolicy: true
      ignorePublicAcls: true
      restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/iam.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-role
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": { "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID" },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": { "StringEquals": { "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:NAMESPACE:logs-irsa-sa" } }
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Policy
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-policy
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/component: irsa
spec:
  forProvider:
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket", "s3:DeleteObject"],
            "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-ENV", "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-ENV/*"]
          }
        ]
      }
---
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicyAttachment
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-attachment
spec:
  forProvider:
    policyArn: "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:policy/logs-irsa-policy"
    roleName: logs-irsa-role
```

**`infra/s3-logs/base/serviceaccount.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: logs-irsa-sa
  namespace: NAMESPACE
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/logs-irsa-role
```

---

**`infra/s3-logs/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
resources:
  - ../../base
patches:
  - path: patch-env.yaml
```
